description: This file implements RADIUS server functionality within a hostapd-based Wi-Fi access point, including TLS event handling, user data management, RADIUS attribute parsing, and server setup.

methods.name: radius_tls_event
methods.description: Handles TLS events such as certificate verification, alerts, and peer certificate info during RADIUS TLS handshake.

methods.name: radius_userdata_init
methods.description: Initializes radius_user_data structure, setting up kvlist and AVL tree.

methods.name: radius_userdata_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with radius_user_data, including kvlist and AVL tree.

methods.name: radius_userdata_load
methods.description: Loads user data into radius_user_data from JSON blob, including users and wildcard patterns.

methods.name: load_userfile
methods.description: Loads user data from specified user file, updating user phases if the file has changed.

methods.name: radius_user_get
methods.description: Retrieves user attribute blob by username, matching against kvlist and wildcard patterns.

methods.name: radius_parse_attr
methods.description: Parses a RADIUS attribute from blob message into structured data.

methods.name: radius_count_attrs
methods.description: Counts total number of attributes and total size needed for RADIUS attributes based on user data.

methods.name: radius_add_attr
methods.description: Adds a RADIUS attribute to the attribute list, handling vendor-specific attributes.

methods.name: radius_parse_attrs
methods.description: Parses and adds RADIUS attributes from user data blobs into attribute list.

methods.name: radius_user_parse_methods
methods.description: Parses EAP methods from user data and updates EAP user structure.

methods.name: radius_user_get_state
methods.description: Retrieves or creates EAP user state for a given username, parsing attributes and storing in AVL tree.

methods.name: radius_get_eap_user
methods.description: Callback to retrieve EAP user info based on identity, supporting phase 1 and phase 2.

methods.name: radius_setup
methods.description: Initializes EAP and TLS configurations, and sets up the radius server.

methods.name: radius_init
methods.description: Initializes radius_state structure, including user data.

methods.name: radius_main
methods.description: Main entry point for RADIUS server, parsing command-line options, initializing server, and running event loop.
